X1 AMP 2.0 MAX Electric Dirt Bike Overview
The X1 AMP 2.0 MAX Electric Dirt Bike is engineered for riders who demand serious power, responsive control, and long-lasting performance. Built for thrilling off-road adventures, from rugged trails to steep climbs, the X1 AMP 2.0 MAX delivers the power and confidence to take on challenging terrain and push your limits.
Unleash Extreme Power
At the heart of the X1 AMP 2.0 MAX is a powerful 7000W mid-drive motor delivering up to 300 N·m of torque. Capable of tackling inclines of up to 70° and reaching speeds of up to 50 mph, it delivers strong acceleration and impressive climbing performance for demanding off-road adventures.
Go Farther with Extended Range
Powered by a 60V 30Ah removable lithium battery, the X1 AMP 2.0 MAX offers a range of up to 60 miles per charge, giving you more freedom to explore.
The removable battery makes charging simple and convenient, allowing you to easily take it indoors for charging after your ride.
Three Riding Modes. One Powerful Ride.
The X1 AMP 2.0 MAX features three dynamic riding modes, allowing you to choose the performance level that matches your riding style and terrain:

PAS 1 – ECO Mode: Ideal for relaxed riding and maximizing range.
PAS 2 – Sport Mode: Delivers stronger acceleration and increased torque for hills and rough terrain.
PAS 3 – Turbo Mode: Unlocks maximum motor performance for rapid acceleration and an exhilarating ride.

Built to Handle Rough Terrain
Designed for demanding off-road conditions, the X1 AMP 2.0 MAX features a capable suspension system that helps absorb impacts and maintain stability across uneven terrain.

Front Suspension: Off-road hydraulic fork for enhanced shock absorption and improved handling.
Rear Suspension: Independent rear suspension for greater stability, comfort, and control on rough trails.

Lighting & Control
Stay visible and in control with an integrated lighting system featuring a powerful 2000-lumen headlight, brake light, and turn signals, all conveniently controlled from the handlebars.
Whether you're navigating technical trails or riding at higher speeds, the X1 AMP 2.0 MAX is engineered to provide confident handling, reliable visibility, and responsive control.
Designed for a Wide Range of Riders
The X1 AMP 2.0 MAX is designed to accommodate riders from approximately 5'1" to 6'5", providing a comfortable and controlled riding position for a wide range of riders.
With the bike arriving 90% pre-assembled, setup is quick and straightforward. Complete a few final steps, gear up, and you're ready to hit the trails.
FOR OFF-ROAD USE ONLY. NOT FOR PUBLIC ROAD USE.
